newsitem.title: SPAIN: German, Spaniard die in Canaries boat accident.
newsitem.headline: German, Spaniard die in Canaries boat accident.

text.p: A German woman tourist and a Spanish man died and some eight people were left trapped inside a cove overnight after a boat accident off the Canary island of La Palma, police said on Saturday.
The two were killed late on Friday night when a strong swell smashed the leisure boat against one of the walls of the cove in the northeast of the island. A German man was injured.

"A German woman and a Spanish man were killed and eight people remained trapped in the cove overnight including those shipwrecked and some rescue workers," a spokesman from the Civil Guard in Tenerife told Reuters on Saturday.
All those trapped were recovered when the rescue operation resumed on Saturday morning, police said.

Police said five German tourists, one of them a young child, and two Spanish workers had been travelling on the leisure boat which had been touring the Cueva Bonita cove, a popular tourist spot in the Tijarafe region.
Police said survivors had escaped to a small beach inside the cove, but could not be rescued due to rough seas. Some rescue workers were also trapped in the cove overnight.
Early on Saturday morning, the rescue operation was resumed and an uninjured four-year old girl and a German man who appeared to have broken a number of ribs, were rescued.
The remainder of those trapped were rescued a few hours later.
Police said all that remained in the cove were the two corpses in the boat.
